boundaries.database: Host-side SQLite behind the repository D1 API. Deterministic write interleavings, not simultaneous Cloudflare instances.
boundaries.workflow: The real Storyboard failure hook is invoked through a host-side probe; the WorkflowScopedDb shell, event, reservation and realtime channel are explicit substitutes. Not durable replay/restart.
boundaries.notification: A guard miss suppresses the parent emit. A surfaced ordinary guard error retains the prior independent emit attempt. Terminal-skip retries, real adapter swallowing and the update/emit window remain open; no browser delivery guarantee.
boundaries.lifecycle: Startup/success writes, final instance-id write-back and child failure hooks remain outside this guard.
